title: Korean Game Companies Financials 2025-2026
subtitle: Open DART financial comparison of eight listed Korean game publishers
description: An independently prepared, transformed extract of public filings from Open DART. Includes company metadata, comparable consolidated financial figures, filing provenance, and a data dictionary. Amounts are KRW unless stated otherwise. No API key or raw filing archives are included. Not investment advice. Source filings remain subject to applicable rights and Open DART terms.
userSpecifiedSources: [Open DART](https://opendart.fss.or.kr/) operated by Korea's Financial Supervisory Service; filing receipt links are preserved in disclosures_2026.csv.
